```plato

//==
// # Signal envelopes and generators
//
// Pure descriptions of synthesized signals: amplitude envelopes, noise
// sources, and periodic waveform generators. Every type here is a parameter
// record, deterministic where it is seeded; the sampled results they describe
// are declared in the first section above.

// An attack-decay-sustain-release amplitude envelope. Sustain is the level
// held after decay as a proportion of peak; the other stages are durations.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Envelope_(music))
type AdsrEnvelope
    implements IValue
{
    Attack: Duration;
    Decay: Duration;
    Sustain: Proportion;
    Release: Duration;
}
```
